# Going

> Going is a flight deal alert service that helps travelers find cheap flights and discover the best times to book destinations worldwide.

Going (formerly Scott's Cheap Flights) monitors airfare prices and notifies members of significant flight deals, offering tools like Google Flights integration and mobile apps for iOS and Android. The platform covers destinations across North America, Europe, Africa, and beyond, with expert travel writers providing booking tips and destination guides.

## Key Topics

- Flight deals and cheap flights
- Best time to visit destinations
- Google Flights integration
- Flight booking strategies
- Goldilocks window pricing
- The Discoverer membership
- iOS and Android apps
- Travel timing optimization
- Destination-specific flight pricing
- International destinations (London, Bali, Barcelona)
- North American destinations (New York, Chicago, Las Vegas, Seattle)
- Flight alerts and notifications
- Travel deal discovery
